title: YIELD NOT TO TEMPTATION
author: Horatio R.Palmer
stanzas: Yield not to temptation, For yielding is sin; Each vict'ry will help you, Some other to win; Fight manfully onward, dark passions subdue; Look ever to Jesus, He will carry you through.
Shun evil companions, Bad language disdain; God's name hold in reverence, Nor take it in vain; Be thoughtful and earnest, Kindhearted and true; Look ever to Jesus, He will carry you through.
To him that o'ercometh, God giveth a crown; Through faith we will conquer, Though often cast down; He who is our Savior, Our strength will renew; Look ever to Jesus, He will carry you through.
chorus: Ask the Savior to help you, Comfort, strengthen and keep you; He is willing to aid you, He will carry you through.
